sections.content: You know *más … que*, *menos … que* and *tan … como* from A2 Unit 6, *aunque* and *sin embargo* from A2 Unit 28. Use them with *pero* to compare cultures and practices.

items.spanish: Esta tradición es diferente de la nuestra.
items.english: This tradition is different from ours.

items.spanish: Aunque son diferentes, tienen algo en común.
items.english: Although they are different, they have something in common.

items.spanish: Esta fiesta es menos formal que la otra, pero tiene un significado parecido.
items.english: This celebration is less formal than the other one, but it has a similar meaning.

sections.content: *Aunque* takes the indicative when the difference is a known fact: *aunque son diferentes*. *Sin embargo* opens a new sentence: *Son diferentes. Sin embargo, tienen algo en común.*
